mintAuthority.summary: USDon (ETH) is an ERC1967 proxy (impl=USDon contract with AccessControlEnumerable); ProxyAdmin (0x5244…) is owned by a TimelockController (2h delay, 0x3715…); MINTER_ROLE held by GMTokenManager (0x2c15…) and a 3-of-6 Safe (0x7607…); DEFAULT_ADMIN = Timelock. BSC is structurally equivalent.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295047 and BSC block 103630432 (2026-06-11): USDon ETH proxy (0xace8…) has EIP-1967 ProxyAdmin=0x5244… owned by TimelockController 0x3715… (2h delay). Token MINTER_ROLE has 2 holders: GMTokenManager (0x2c15…) and 3-of-6 Ondo Safe (0x7607…, no modules). DEFAULT_ADMIN = Timelock; Timelock PROPOSER = 4-of-7 Safe, EXECUTOR = 1-of-8 Safe + EOA. BSC structurally equivalent: MINTER_ROLE[0]=GMTokenManager(0x91f8…), MINTER_ROLE[1]=contract, DEFAULT_ADMIN=0x8860… (contract). Impl (USDon) confirmed on Blockscout. Regulation S restricts U.S.-person minting; no permissionless mint path. USDon is issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited; Ondo's Trust & Transparency page scopes its only third-party feed (Ankura Trust) to tokenized-stock holdings, not USDon's brokerage cash, and no dated independent report of USDon's specific cash reserve was found, so reconciliation is unknown. Ondo's own disclaimer states the issuer and tokens are not registered or licensed by the BVI FSC, SEC, CFTC or any financial regulator, so supervision is none.. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: direct minters have no firm economic cap, and no USDon-specific recurring reserve reconciliation, prudential supervisor, or independent attestor is evidenced.
